notes.title: Update: Ready for more variation?
notes.content: The level order in the cups was optimized for more variety and chaos. Have fun!

notes.title: Spermula 1 Full Version is now available
notes.content:
Spermula 1 is exiting the Early Access Phase.

The finished game contains 16 levels which take the sperms into sex robots, witch lairs, space, ghost castles, disco floors and places we can't name here.

The full version also features:
[/list]
[*] 2 game modes (single player and local multiplayer)
[*] 10 weapons and powerups
[*] 4 different speedrun modes for each level
[*] 16 custom songs for a fitting soundtrack
[*] 8 unlockable secret characters
[*] 21 Steam achievements
[*] and lots of stupid jokes
[/list]

Enjoy Spermula 1 - and you're still welcome to leave us feedback in the Steam Community.

notes.title: New Spooky Cup added! Including Witch character!
notes.content:
We release the fourth and final cup: Supernatural and Spooky.
The last cup features four crazy levels with new obstacles and soundtracks.

This cup includes a witch level, fitting to start off the Halloween season.
And you can unlock a witch character by finishing the cup with 6/6 stars!

This is the final update before the full release later this year.

Get Spermula1 now, while we're still in Early Access Phase!

notes.title: New cup with 4 new levels, 2 new game modes, features
notes.content:
[b]Whats new? [/b]

[b]1. Gold Cup[/b]
The third cup takes you into space.
Four stunning new levels of the alien kind.

[b]2. Speedrun Modes[/b]
Beat your own highscores in all unlocked levels.
Each level has four different modes with separate highscores.
Beware of the rage inducing No Damage mode!

[b]3. Threesome Mode[/b]
Play a mini cup out of three randomly chosen levels.

[b]4. Damage display[/b]
You can now see directly which enemy hit you and which other sperm you hit.

[b]5. Balancing update[/b]
Updated traits for the different sperm characters.

notes.title: Added a new difficulty: Hard!
notes.content:
Whats new?

[list]
[*] Added a new difficulty: Hard!
[*] You can now play through the two cups in easy or hard mode
[*] Added two more powerups to the game
[*] Improved balancing for the powerups
[*] And lots of other improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Added one new cup with four new levels
notes.content:
Whats new?
[list]
[*]Added one new cup: The silver cup has four new levels, each with its own soundtrack
[*]Improved balancing of the attributes of the different sperm characters 
[*]Two new unlockable characters: Finish each cup with the max grade and unlock a new character
[*]As many requested you can now change the up/down direction in the game
[*]And lots of other improvements
[/list]
Have fun and leave us feedback on the community page.

notes.title: First Early Access version released today!
notes.content:
Hello all,

today we released the first Early Access version of [b]Spermula 1[/b]

Leave your feedback about the game here in the Community Hub.

Thanks for checking out the game and have fun spermracing!

Vicious Vortex
